## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. VXX (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -16.04%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +1.68%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND provide confirmation, with reflation signal CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND supporting cyclicals.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear easing: VXX (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -16.04%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.71%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.15% | 1M: -0.24%) BELOW TREND implies HYG/LQD showing strain. Reflation/cyclicals: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: UUP (Dollar) (1W: +0.33% | 1M: -0.41%) → flat RECOVERY while TLT (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND and the yield curve (Level: 1.0551) → flat BELOW TREND keep conditions mixed.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals leading: XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND and Industrials (1W: +2.66% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND; Materials (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND — style: Value/ cyclicals over Growth.

**5. US vs Global?**
US mixed: SPY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +0.86%) CORRECTION while EM outperforms: EEM (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND and China FXI (1W: +2.57% | 1M: +2.94%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation rising: IBIT (1W: +7.76% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND, ARKK (1W: +2.06% | 1M: +0.73%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.52% | 1M: +1.58%) ABOVE TREND show risk-tolerant flows.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Reflation theme: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND and DBB (1W: +4.42% | 1M: +10.30%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals showing short-term pullbacks with GLD (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%) CORRECTION and SLV (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +30.17%) CORRECTION.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy leadership: XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +2.35% | 1M: -0.86%) RECOVERY; natural gas weak: UNG (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -24.82%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
Confirmed: Cyclicals and commodities (XLE and CPER both 1W/1M positive) and VXX falling back up the risk profile. Divergence: Precious metals (PPLT (1W: -7.10% | 1M: +34.87%) CORRECTION, SLV (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +30.17%) CORRECTION, GLD (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%) CORRECTION) and only 5/11 sector breadth limit the breadth of the rally.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclicals and reflation exposure via XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND and Industrial exposures (XAR (1W: +5.64% | 1M: +14.28%) ABOVE TREND, ITA (1W: +3.86% | 1M: +12.33%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to tech risk as XLK (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND shows weakness and maintain neutral stance on core duration (TLT (1W: -0.32% | 1M: -1.41%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND if oil and CPI components keep reflation theme intact; XME/XAR/ITA (1W: +2.99%/+5.64%/+3.86%) ABOVE TREND for industrial cycle. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -0.11%) BELOW TREND and XLU (1W: -0.19% | 1M: -1.78%) BELOW TREND on rotation pressure.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND and DBB (1W: +4.42% | 1M: +10.30%) ABOVE TREND for cyclical reflation. BEARISH: UNG (1W: -9.21% | 1M: -24.82%) BELOW TREND and short-term profit taking in precious metals (GLD (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%) CORRECTION).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency signal), HYG/LQD ~0.7321 (credit stress read), SPY/TLT 7.86 (stocks vs bonds pivot), XLK/XLF 2.58 (tech vs financials tilt).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive with confirmation from VXX (1W: -2.19% | 1M: -16.04%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND and Stocks vs Bonds (SPY/TLT) (1W: +0.68% | 1M: +1.68%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND. Cyclicals and commodities (XLE (1W: +6.09% | 1M: +2.99%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +2.68% | 1M: +11.32%) ABOVE TREND) are showing strength. Key risk: limited breadth and precious-metals divergences (GLD (1W: -1.91% | 1M: +5.66%) CORRECTION, SLV (1W: -2.87% | 1M: +30.17%) CORRECTION) — monitor HYG/LQD (credit) and VXX levels.
